stem:
A basketball team was losing by 18 points. Then 3 players each scored an equal number of points, and the team won the game. The opposing team did not score any additional points. The inequality 3p > 18 can be used to determine the number of points each of the 3 players scored to win the game.

What is the solution to the inequality?
instruction: Select a ray. Move the point on the ray to the correct place on the number line.
visual_elements: Number line from 0 to 9 with marked points and arrows on both ends
notes: Standard 6.9(B), question 20 from 2024 STAAR; options represent rays with open/closed circles and directions
